## tsa-a02-v03 (3)
Here / reason-itself-is-the-yoga-limb / thus / how / does-he-discriminate / If-asked / it-is-said / this / Lord / self-light-natured / own-self / Therein / what / is-done / by-means / Not-attainment-of-nature / from-eternity / not-notification / from-self-shiningness / not-removal-of-covering / since-covering-of-any-kind-is-impossible / not-entry-into-it / since-there-is-no-distinct-enterer // tsa02-p01
l2: Here "yoga-limb" means one thing only: thinking it through. But what is there to think? The Lord, who is self-shining, is yourself. So what could a means do? It can't get you your nature — you have it eternally. It can't inform you — you shine already. It can't strip a covering — there is none. It can't take you inside — there's no outsider to go in.
l3:
Here "yoga-limb" means one thing only — thinking it through.
But what is there to think? The Lord is self-shining, and that Lord is you.
So what could a means do? It cannot get you your nature — you have it eternally.
It cannot inform you — you shine already.
It cannot strip a covering — there is none.
It cannot take you inside — there is no outsider to go in.

sanskrit: kaś cātra upāyaḥ tasyāpi vyatiriktasya anupapatteḥ tasmāt samastam idam ekaṃ cinmātratattvaṃ kālena akalitaṃ deśena aparicchinnam upādhibhir amlānam ākṛtibhir aniyantritaṃ śabdair asaṃdiṣṭaṃ pramāṇair aprapañcitaṃ kālādeḥ pramāṇaparyantasya svecchayaiva svarūpalābhanimittaṃ ca svatantram ānandaghanaṃ tattvaṃ tad eva ca aham tatraiva antar mayi viśvaṃ pratibimbitam evaṃ dṛḍhaṃ viviñcānasya śaśvad eva pārameśvaraḥ samāveśo nirupāyaka eva tasya ca na mantrapūjādhyānacaryādiniyantraṇā kācit

## tsa-a02-v04 (4)
What-means-here / of-it-too / as-distinct / impossibility / Hence / all-this / one / consciousness-only-reality / unmeasured-by-time / undelimited-by-place / unfaded-by-attributes / uncontrolled-by-forms / unindicated-by-words / unelaborated-by-valid-means / and-the-cause-of-own-nature-attainment / of-time-to-valid-means / by-own-will-alone / autonomous / bliss-dense / reality / that-itself / I / therein / within-me / the-universe / reflected / For-one-thus-firmly-discriminating / ever / Lordly-immersion / means-less-itself / for-it / no-constraint-at-all / by-mantra-worship-meditation-conduct // tsa02-p01
l2: And the means itself, as something separate from you, is equally impossible. So: all this is one reality, consciousness and nothing else — time can't measure it, place can't bound it, qualities can't fade it, shapes can't rule it, words can't point it out, proofs can't build it up. By its own will it is what lets everything from time to proof arrive at its nature; free, thick bliss; and that is I, with the universe mirrored inside me. Who sees this steadily is immersed in the Lord always, without means — no mantra binds him, no worship, no sitting, no observance.
